rounds.title: Banner baseline
rounds.note: First drawing of the SDK banner (et-banner), drawn by its mock from @ethlete/components/design on the page: one banner per type (info, success, warning, error) with icon, heading, description, a text-button action where the type has one and the xs dismiss icon button, a banner without dismiss, and all four stacked. info takes the colour theme around it (brand); success keeps brand too, as this product registers no success theme; warning forces warning and error danger. States: each type, without-dismiss, close and action hover and focus-visible (info), close and action focus-visible (error). Today on light the mint banner barely separates from the page: its 1px edge (24% primary) is 1.15:1 against the page and 1.10:1 against its 8% tint (warning 1.40:1 / 1.29:1, danger 1.62:1 / 1.44:1); the focus rings of the dismiss button and the action are mint, 1.28:1 against the tint (warning 2.92:1, danger 4.28:1). Dark: edge 2.24:1 against the page (warning 1.54:1, danger 1.30:1), mint rings 11.53:1 (warning 5.15:1, danger 3.55:1). Fixed numbers (text on the banner fill, all above 4.5:1): heading 17.24:1 light, 14.66:1 dark (warning 16.46 / 15.73, danger 15.88 / 16.41); description (muted) 7.51:1 / 5.92:1 (warning 7.17 / 6.36, danger 6.92 / 6.63); icon, action label and dismiss icon in ink 5.27:1 / 11.53:1 (warning 6.51 / 7.65, danger 5.73 / 6.19). Tint against the page, numbers only (Q98 open): 1.04:1 light, 1.17:1 dark (warning 1.09 / 1.09, danger 1.13 / 1.05). Q101 does not arise: the banner has no filled button. Variant b applies decided rules Q88 (focus rings in --et-theme-color-ink-solid) and Q99 rule a (the mint tint gets an ink edge: the 1px border in ink), ink following the scheme. Because b adds a visible edge, Q102 arises: variant c is b with the border in light-dark(ink, today's 24% primary), dark as today. Variant a shows today. Not this round's question: the tint against the page (Q98); the text-button action's font, which is the button's own.

a.note: Today: 1px edge in 24% primary, focus rings in primary. Light: mint edge 1.15:1 against the page, 1.10:1 against the tint (warning 1.40 / 1.29, danger 1.62 / 1.44); rings 1.28:1 against the tint (warning 2.92:1, danger 4.28:1). Dark: edge 2.24:1 against the page (warning 1.54, danger 1.30); rings 11.53:1 (warning 5.15, danger 3.55). Text as in the round note.

b.note: Pick. Decided rules Q88 and Q99 rule a, not a new call: the banner border and every focus ring in --et-theme-color-ink-solid; the tint stays. Light: edge 5.48:1 against the page, 5.27:1 against the tint (warning 7.09 / 6.51, danger 6.47 / 5.73); rings 5.27:1 against the tint (warning 6.51, danger 5.73). Dark: ink is mint, so the edge jumps from 2.24:1 to 13.50:1 against the page (warning 8.35:1, danger 6.48:1) and rings read 11.53:1 (warning 7.65, danger 6.19). Picked to match the badge, chip and progress-steps picks: ink follows the scheme. Q102 open; if dark should stay as today, take c.

c.note: b with the border in light-dark(ink, 24% primary): light equal to b (edge 5.48:1 against the page, warning 7.09:1, danger 6.47:1); dark as today (edge 2.24:1, warning 1.54:1, danger 1.30:1). Focus rings stay in ink in both schemes (Q88): light 5.27:1, dark 11.53:1 (warning 7.65, danger 6.19). It keys on color-scheme, not on the surface; that is my reading of rule a, not a decided rule (Q102).
